source_revision: recorded on an uncommitted worktree during the win8 API-floor expansion; kaptaind auto-commits interleaved with the session, so pin the working-tree state by the hashes below rather than by a revision
first_gate: Real Windows execution of the win8-floor images on Windows 8 or later
summary: Sash admits an API floor at build time. --api-floor win10 (default) emits the per-monitor-v2 adapter of the first proof and is byte-identical to the SASH-ENT-002 record: all six recorded win10 pairs reproduce. --api-floor win8 emits the system-DPI-aware legacy adapter: SetProcessDPIAware before window creation, one GetDeviceCaps(LOGPIXELSY) process-DPI read, SystemParametersInfoW for the message font, AdjustWindowRectEx for the frame, no Windows 10 1703+ per-monitor import, no WM_DPICHANGED handling, and a .Legacy assembly identity the verifier reads back as the floor. The scene admits identically on both floors; only the Win32 adapter and the manifest differ. The win8 floor is the lowest the pinned stable toolchain can produce because the pc-windows-msvc standard library imports api-ms-win-core-synch-l1-2-0.dll (WaitOnAddress, Windows 8+). Windows 7, Vista, and XP are refused with that reason; win8 and ARM64 are refused together because ARM64 Windows did not exist before Windows 10. The legacy evidence carries honest dispositions: the static background claim is rewritten (no per-monitor font recreation) and every legacy image declares the system-DPI strategy under a dpi disposition. Nothing has been launched on any Windows version; every runtime claim stays BLOCKED.

The import table keeps the same five DLL names as the win10 image; the per-monitor functions are absent from the adapter text and are pinned out of the generated source. Not launched.

legacy_interactive_x64_link.note: The interactive legacy adapter keeps the edit subclass, clipboard gate, keyboard plan, and D1 commit protocol; only the DPI strategy differs from the win10 adapter. Not launched.

legacy_floor_refusals.note: admit_floor refuses win7, vista, and xp with the toolchain reason (tier-3 *-win7-windows-msvc needs nightly -Z build-std; Sash does not download a compiler). The CLI refuses win8 with aarch64-pc-windows-msvc. CLI tests pin both refusals.
